blind.description: A stone wall segment built from dark grey rectangular ashlar blocks, capped with a stone coping. The front face features three stacked horizontal rectangular recessed niches filled with ossuary remains: the top niche contains a neat row of human skulls, the middle niche holds skulls stacked over leg bones, and the bottom niche contains skulls resting amid bone piles. The back face features corresponding recessed openings showing the dark interiors behind the remains. The stonework is weathered dark brownish-grey with subtle edge wear, sitting directly on the ground with a flat base.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular stone top cap with slightly rounded corners, split down the center by a subtle seam line.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: deep recessed interior backing of the niches appears pitch black shadow/unlit
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.1 times the height of the figure (roughly 6.3 ft tall), and about 0.5 times as wide as the wall is tall (around 3 to 3.5 ft wide).
